content: .{@-वादिन्@} {%m.%} upholder of the usage theory {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} one who holds that transactions of old persons (वृद्धव्यवहार) can explain the knowledge of the connection between शब्द and its अर्थ by the younger ones; अपि च व्यवहारवादिनः प्रत्यक्षमुपदिशन्ति कल्पयन्ति इतरे सम्बन्धारम् <ls>ŚB. on MS. 1. 1. 5</ls>.
